module origen_062909(
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire EN,
    input wire [3:0] C,
    output reg [3:0] D
);
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset)
            D <= 4'b0000;
        else if (EN)
            D <= C;
    end
endmodule

module FETCH(
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire EN,
    input wire [7:0] D,
    output wire [3:0] instr,
    output wire [3:0] oprnd
);
    FFD4 ff_instr (
        .clk(clk),
        .reset(reset),
        .EN(EN),
        .C(D[7:4]),
        .D(instr)
    );

    FFD4 ff_oprnd (
        .clk(clk),
        .reset(reset),
        .EN(EN),
        .C(D[3:0]),
        .D(oprnd)
    );
endmodule

module contador(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire EN,
    input wire blo,
    input wire [11:0] load,
    output reg [11:0] val
);
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst)
            val <= 12'b0;
        else if (blo)
            val <= load;
        else if (EN)
            val <= val + 1;
    end
endmodule

module Mrom(
    input wire [11:0] address,
    output reg [7:0] D
);
    reg [7:0] memory [0:4095];

    initial begin
        $readmemh("Mrom.list", memory);
    end

    always @(*) begin
        D = memory[address];
    end
endmodule

module integrador(
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire ENPC,
    input wire ENF,
    input wire blo,
    input wire [11:0] load,
    output wire [7:0] P_B,
    output wire [3:0] instr,
    output wire [3:0] oprnd
);
    wire [11:0] address;

    contador program_counter (
        .clk(clk),
        .rst(reset),
        .EN(ENPC),
        .blo(blo),
        .load(load),
        .val(address)
    );

    Mrom instruction_memory (
        .address(address),
        .D(P_B)
    );

    FETCH fetch_unit (
        .clk(clk),
        .reset(reset),
        .EN(ENF),
        .D(P_B),
        .instr(instr),
        .oprnd(oprnd)
    );
endmodule
